summary: A mayor or county executive reports on the year to residents and the council.
realLife: Six local addresses read in full: three of them from towns under 50,000 people.
sources: Kerry Thomson, Bloomington (Indiana) mayor, inauguration remarks, Jan 1, 2024: https://bloomington.in.gov/sites/default/files/2024-01/swearing%20in%20speech%201.1.24_0.pdf
Harford County (Maryland) executive, State of the County, 2026: https://www.harfordcountymd.gov/DocumentCenter/View/29859/2026-State-of-the-County-Address-Speech
Charles Patricelli, Watervliet (New York) mayor, State of the City, Feb 20, 2025: https://watervlietny.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/State-of-City-2025_JPR-Edits.pdf

Jen Metzger, Ulster County (New York) executive, State of the County, Feb 18, 2026: https://www.ulstercountyny.gov/files/assets/countysite/v/1/county-executive/documents/state-of-the-county-2026/ulster-county-executive-2026-state-of-the-county-address-english.pdf
Derrick Wood, Dumfries (Virginia) mayor, State of the Town, June 5, 2025: https://derrickrwood.com/news/2025-state-of-town-transcript

Joseph Winfield, Oro Valley (Arizona) mayor, State of the Town, Oct 30, 2025: https://www.orovalleyaz.gov/files/assets/public/v/1/documents/mayor-and-council/state-of-the-town/2025-state-of-the-town-address-transcript.pdf
Read in full by the local and campaign speeches writer's helper, Nov 24, 2026; every description is a paraphrase.
